notes.max_E_ebh_not_valid: e-BH on max_E is reported as requested but is not formally valid: the maximum of a test martingale is not an e-value (E[max E] can exceed 1). Final E is a valid e-value.
notes.subsampled_definition: n_full = all hypotheses of the setting; family thresholds use n_full (conservative for subsampled settings).
